service.description: The push gate. For a repository Smithy has, refuses a push (refs/for/* included): by an account without a confirmed address, or by no account; by an account suspended on the site; on a site that no longer mounts Smithy; to an archived repository; and one whose pack (packBytes) would take the repository past its namespace's size limit for one repository (the account's, or its nearest group's, else the site's default). What the repository stores is the framework's count (get#GitRepositoryUsage), asked for this repository alone; a push is refused when it cannot be read. A push that adds nothing (packBytes 0, deletes only) is not held to the size. A push to refs/for/[branch] (forReview; a page's proposal runs the same rule) needs view of a repository that takes merge requests and an account that is not silenced there; by an account without Developer it is at most 50 MiB, with at most 200 MiB of such pushes a day over every repository (and no more than one repository of the account's own may hold), counted against the pusher and not against the repository's limit, and it opens no more merge requests a day than the account's trust level allows (limitReached).

parameter.name: forReview
parameter.description: A ref of the push is refs/for/[branch]

parameter.name: pushOptions
parameter.description: The push's options: topic=[name] names the merge request a push to review goes to

parameter.name: refUpdates
parameter.description: The refs of the push: each with forReview and targetBranch for refs/for/[branch]

actions.script: for (const problem of ec.resource.script("component://mr-mantle/service/mantle/smithy/Smithy.js").checkPush({repositoryId, userId, packBytes, forReview, refUpdates, pushOptions})) ec.message.addError(problem)

service.description: The Git LFS upload check (the framework's check#GitLfsUpload contract): LFS uploads do not pass pre-receive, so for a repository Smithy has this refuses an upload by an account without a confirmed address or suspended on the site, on a site that no longer mounts Smithy, to an archived repository, when the usage cannot be read, and one whose bytes (uploadBytes) would take the Git LFS files of the repository's namespace (the account's repositories, or those below the group whose limit it is) past their limit.

actions.script: for (const problem of ec.resource.script("component://mr-mantle/service/mantle/smithy/Smithy.js").checkLfsUpload({repositoryId, userId, uploadBytes})) ec.message.addError(problem)
